subject.title: fix(agents): treat unterminated Responses SSE stream as error, not success

question: Should every provider configured with `api: "openai-responses"` be required to emit a documented terminal event, and should this proof-positive branch be the canonical fix over https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109133?
rationale: The OpenAI contract supports fail-closed behavior, but OpenClaw intentionally serves third-party compatible providers whose terminal-event compliance is not established; selecting the permanent compatibility policy and canonical branch requires maintainer ownership.

options.title: Land this branch universally
options.body: Require completed, incomplete, or failed terminal events on all Responses routes and use this branch's real HTTP/SSE proof as the canonical implementation.

options.title: Narrow strict enforcement
options.body: Apply fail-closed EOF behavior only to known native-compliant endpoints or introduce a provider-owned compatibility capability for nonconforming proxies.

options.title: Prefer the competing branch
options.body: Select https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109133 after it supplies equally strong real HTTP/SSE and interrupted tool-use proof.

recommendation.title: Land this branch universally
recommendation.body: Require completed, incomplete, or failed terminal events on all Responses routes and use this branch's real HTTP/SSE proof as the canonical implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is the repository-wide compatibility contract for native and custom Responses providers, and recent history shows direct review of that shared boundary.
